_about: Radio and fight barks for the slice, Writer's placeholder pass (VS-31, 2026-10-09; final text at VS-37, Ross approves). Each conversation id IS the bark id the Level Designer and Combat Designer already named (bark_j1_arrive in docs/maps/junkyard.md, kasp_rig_intro and vela_rig_zap_relays in combat/bosses/hushmaster.json, kasp_mech_plate in junk_mech.json, and so on), so a trigger plays the conversation with that id. Most barks are ONE line; a few are two lines to be played back to back (Kasp's spec recitals). Speakers: vela (the voice in Red's ear: prim, exact, ex-Signals; she logs Red's nods as statements; the radio box shows her name from data/text/slice_ui.json) and kasp (an office manager who means every word; he recites the rig's specs mid-fight). Keep lines short: the radio box holds two or three short rows. 'bark_variants' lists the barks that have several alternatives: kasp_rig_quiet_hours (play the first one the first time the pulse comes, then cycle the rest) and kasp_mech_plate (one per plate, in order). NEW IDS the Writer added that no data names yet (use or ignore): bark_j2_overclock_idle (a hijacked turret with nothing to shoot, the gag in encounters.json hack_showcase), bark_arena_save (the arena gate terminal: 'last save before the Sergeant'), kasp_arena_reveal (the camera shot of Kasp in the seat), kasp_mech_assemble (the cranes pour scrap into the Heap), kasp_pa_j2, kasp_pa_j3, kasp_pa_j4 (Kasp over the yard loudspeaker as Red enters each room: optional). Please keep the spec recitals word for word until Ross approves the final text; the dish line in kasp_rig_quiet_hours is one the Creative Director has marked.

bark_j1_arrive.speaker: vela
bark_j1_arrive.text: Yard 9. Everything they confiscate ends up here. Stay quiet. ...I know. I am logging it anyway.

bark_j1_lockon.speaker: vela
bark_j1_lockon.text: Wolves. Lock on, Red. It keeps your sword pointed at the right end.

bark_j1_zap.speaker: vela
bark_j1_zap.text: That fuse box on the pylon feeds the door. Zap it. I am ninety percent sure. I rounded up.

bark_j2_turret.speaker: vela
bark_j2_turret.text: Wall turret. Slow bursts, long gaps. Zap it, EMP it, or sprint. I will not write it up.

bark_j2_overclock.speaker: vela
bark_j2_overclock.text: That turret on the ledge. Overclock it, and it fights for you. Ten seconds. Make them count.

bark_j2_overclock_idle.speaker: vela
bark_j2_overclock_idle.text: Overclocked, with nothing to shoot. It is firing at the chute. The chute has done nothing wrong.

bark_j2_crane.speaker: vela
bark_j2_crane.text: There. The crane, up ahead. Whatever it is holding, we will want it moved. Keep climbing.

bark_j3_pit.speaker: vela
bark_j3_pit.text: Nine metres of coolant. I have measured your jump, Red. Respectfully: no.

bark_j3_crane.speaker: vela
bark_j3_crane.text: Crane controls, at the foot of its leg. Overclock them, and carry that girder over the pit.

bark_j3_emp.speaker: vela
bark_j3_emp.text: Drones, from that dispenser. EMP buys you a pause. Zap the power node on the roof to end it.

bark_j3_lastsave.speaker: vela
bark_j3_lastsave.text: Last chance to save, courier. Past this, there is no coming back this way.

bark_j4_wrecks.speaker: vela
bark_j4_wrecks.text: Those are... large. Someone built something enormous here, once. Keep walking.

bark_j4_stand.speaker: vela
bark_j4_stand.text: Shutters are down. Two heavies, three wolves, two turrets. The turrets can be borrowed.

bark_j4_loader.speaker: vela
bark_j4_loader.text: That is a loader. Wake it up, Red. Press the button and climb in.

bark_j4_smash.speaker: vela
bark_j4_smash.text: Straight ahead. That wall is scrap, and you are not. Smash it.

bark_j5_start.speaker: vela
bark_j5_start.text: Hacks are off while you drive. Fine. You have arms the size of buses now.

bark_j5_smash.speaker: vela
bark_j5_smash.text: Cars, containers, walls. All fair game. I will file the paperwork later.

bark_j5_gate.speaker: vela
bark_j5_gate.text: The big gate. Hit it until it stops being a gate.

bark_arena_save.speaker: vela
bark_arena_save.text: Last save before the Sergeant. Use it. He has a rig and a speech.

kasp_pa_j2.speaker: kasp
kasp_pa_j2.text: ATTENTION YARD 9: a courier has no appointment. Please remind her. Firmly.

kasp_pa_j3.speaker: kasp
kasp_pa_j3.text: ATTENTION YARD 9: the crane is not available. The crane has been reminded.

kasp_pa_j4.speaker: kasp
kasp_pa_j4.text: ALL UNITS: stop the courier. Quietly. Loudly. Whichever is faster.

kasp_arena_reveal.speaker: kasp
kasp_arena_reveal.text: {face:smug}MEMO. Yard 9 is closed. You are in Yard 9. This is a clerical problem.

kasp_arena_reveal.speaker: kasp
kasp_arena_reveal.text: Sergeant Kasp, jammer division. I will be your obstacle this evening.

kasp_rig_intro.speaker: kasp
kasp_rig_intro.text: Eight legs. Hydraulic knees. Heated seat. Cupholder.

kasp_rig_intro.speaker: kasp
kasp_rig_intro.text: {face:shouting}You are about to be defeated by a cupholder, courier.

kasp_rig_relay_1.speaker: kasp
kasp_rig_relay_1.text: That relay was a four-hundred-credit part. I am deducting it from your pending.

kasp_rig_pairs_2.speaker: kasp
kasp_rig_pairs_2.text: Four legs remain. You have two. I am still ahead on legs.

kasp_rig_pairs_3.speaker: kasp
kasp_rig_pairs_3.text: {face:flustered}Two legs. That is within tolerance. I have decided it is within tolerance.

kasp_rig_quiet_hours.speaker: kasp
kasp_rig_quiet_hours.text: Item nine: receiver dish. Salvage-grade, genuine antique. Hears the call better than anything in the catalog.

kasp_rig_quiet_hours.speaker: kasp
kasp_rig_quiet_hours.text: Which I will now use to cancel it. Quiet Hours.

kasp_rig_quiet_hours_v2.speaker: kasp
kasp_rig_quiet_hours_v2.text: Quiet Hours. Your second button is cancelled.

kasp_rig_quiet_hours_v3.speaker: kasp
kasp_rig_quiet_hours_v3.text: Hacks are a noise. Noise is a violation.

kasp_rig_quiet_hours_v4.speaker: kasp
kasp_rig_quiet_hours_v4.text: Effective now: please stop hearing things.

kasp_rig_dish_broken.speaker: kasp
kasp_rig_dish_broken.text: {face:flustered}The DISH?! That was a genuine antique! It was the only one in the catalog!

kasp_rig_topple.speaker: kasp
kasp_rig_topple.text: Rig status: horizontal. Filing a form.

kasp_rig_topple.speaker: kasp
kasp_rig_topple.text: This is not a fall. It is an unscheduled descent.

kasp_rig_jack_in.speaker: kasp
kasp_rig_jack_in.text: {face:shouting}What is that cable? The cable is not in the spec! THE CABLE IS NOT IN THE SPEC!

kasp_escape.speaker: kasp
kasp_escape.text: This is not a retreat. It is a scheduled relocation. CRANE! I have the form!

kasp_mech_assemble.speaker: kasp
kasp_mech_assemble.text: {face:shouting}YARD, ASSEMBLE. That is a work order. Scrap, report to Heap B.

vela_get_to_loader.speaker: vela
vela_get_to_loader.text: He is building something huge out of the yard. Get to the loader, Red. Run!

kasp_mech_intro.speaker: kasp
kasp_mech_intro.text: The Heap. Forty metres. Specifications pending. Heated seat: salvaged. Cupholder: transferred.

kasp_mech_intro.speaker: kasp
kasp_mech_intro.text: Everything else is scrap. Which is, I am told, the point.

kasp_mech_plate.speaker: kasp
kasp_mech_plate.text: That plate was load-bearing. Everything is load-bearing. It is a mech.

kasp_mech_plate_v2.speaker: kasp
kasp_mech_plate_v2.text: Two plates. TWO. I am filing a complaint with the yard.

kasp_mech_plate_v3.speaker: kasp
kasp_mech_plate_v3.text: That is three. I have run out of plates to be insulted by.

kasp_mech_plate_v4.speaker: kasp
kasp_mech_plate_v4.text: That was the last plate. I would like it noted that the cab is still heated.

kasp_mech_core.speaker: kasp
kasp_mech_core.text: {face:flustered}The cab! Do you see the cab? That is the heated seat! Aim somewhere else!

kasp_mech_last_stand.speaker: kasp
kasp_mech_last_stand.text: {face:shouting}Enough. This is a Priority One memo. ALL ARMS. SWING.

kasp_mech_defeat.speaker: kasp
kasp_mech_defeat.text: I would like to dispute this outcome. In writing. In triplicate. Please hold.

vela_rig_zap_relays.speaker: vela
vela_rig_zap_relays.text: The relay boxes on the legs. Zap one, and that pair of legs folds. The sword only clinks.

vela_rig_turret.speaker: vela
vela_rig_turret.text: Those gun pylons are powered down. Overclock one, and it will shoot the relays for you.

vela_rig_emp_drones.speaker: vela
vela_rig_emp_drones.text: Drones! EMP gets all three at once. Second button, Red.

vela_rig_hit_dish.speaker: vela
vela_rig_hit_dish.text: Quiet Hours! Hit the dish before your hacks lock! Zap it, or use the sword!

vela_mech_open_plate.speaker: vela
vela_mech_open_plate.text: Each attack opens an armour plate. Bait a swing, then hit the shoulder.

vela_mech_jump_ring.speaker: vela
vela_mech_jump_ring.text: That ring is coming across the ground. Jump it!
